overview: Dr. Arko Sen completed his Ph.D. training in Pharmacology from Wayne State School of Medicine in Detroit, Michigan, and then completed his postdoctoral training at the Salk Institute for Biological Studies in San Diego, California. He joined the Department of Genetics in August 2023 and his lab studies how non-coding genetic variations drive tumorigenesis of pediatric tumors.
